agents.manage_link: Agentic members are managed on the Agents page →

create.title: Create an agent
create.description: Define an AI agent that can be assigned work items. LLM platforms load its definition through the API or MCP.

fields.name: Name
fields.handle_help: Used to reference the agent from the API and MCP. Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _.
fields.avatar_emoji_help: Optional. Leave empty to use the default agent icon.
fields.summary_placeholder: One line on what this agent does
fields.summary_help: Shown in agent lists so LLMs can pick the right agent.
fields.goal_help: What the agent optimises for and how success is measured.
fields.goal_placeholder: Catch regressions before they reach production
fields.how_it_works_help: Approach, boundaries and constraints, in Markdown.
fields.instructions_help: Operating instructions the LLM follows, like a system prompt.
fields.capabilities_help: Short tags that describe what the agent is good at. Press Enter to add.
fields.owner_help: The person accountable for this agent.

list.open_items: {count, plural, one {# open work item} other {# open work items}}

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.description: Agentic members are AI agents with a profile, goal and workflow. Assign them work items and load their definitions into LLM platforms through the API or MCP.

detail.not_found: This agent could not be found.
detail.no_access: Only workspace admins and members can view agents.
detail.shared_notice: This definition is shared with LLM platforms through the API and MCP. Never put secrets in it.

workflow.description: The steps the agent follows, in order. Mark steps where it must stop and wait for a person to approve.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Describe the tools the agent should use. This is descriptive only; never add secrets or credentials.
tools.usage_placeholder: When and how to use it (Markdown)
tools.hints_help: Advisory settings for the LLM platform, such as model or temperature, as a JSON object.

context.title: LLM context
context.help: Exactly what LLM platforms receive for this agent.
context.preview_error: The preview could not be rendered. Check the fields for errors.
context.connect_title: Use this agent in an LLM platform
context.connect_help: Connect Claude Code, ChatGPT or another MCP client with a personal API token.
context.llm_prompt_example: Load the Cybernetics agent @{handle} in workspace {workspace} with get_agent_context and act as it. Then work through its queue with list_agent_work_items and get_agent_task_brief.

projects.description: Agents can only be assigned work items in projects they have access to.
projects.empty: This agent has no project access yet.

settings.admin_only: Only workspace admins can change agent settings.
settings.accept_description: When off, the agent keeps its current work items but cannot be assigned new ones.
settings.pause_description: A paused agent cannot receive new assignments. Its definition stays available.
settings.archive_description: Removes the agent from its projects. Existing assignments are kept for history.
settings.restore_description: Makes the agent active again with its previous project access.
settings.delete_description: This permanently removes the agent. Type {handle} to confirm.

toasts.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
